result.summary: The page renders well overall with no major breakage. One minor layout issue was found where rating text on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card appears clipped at the right screen edge.

issues.description: The rating text '4.8 (500+)' on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' vertical list is clipped at the right screen edge — the closing parenthesis is cut off. Unlike a horizontal carousel, this is a standard vertical list item whose content should not run past the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/margin to the card row or allow the rating text to wrap so the full '4.8 (500+)' text fits within the viewport width.
